title: Studique
desc: A campus platform for SRMIST students that brings attendance, marks, and resources into one clear and reliable system.
mobileDesc: A campus platform for SRMIST students to manage academics in one reliable place.
impact: While other platforms charge or crash, Studique has stayed free and reliable. We've spent hundreds of nights refining it based on real feedback, and the community response has been incredible.
overview: I built Studique because university portals were slow and confusing. At SRMIST, we had to jump through multiple sites just for basics like attendance. We wanted something made for students-fast, reliable, and all in one place.
problem: University systems were failing0,000+ students. Daily friction from server crashes and bad UX meant missing critical updates. We saw a gap that needed a smooth, student-first solution.
solution: We built a companion with a smart caching layer that stays fast even when official servers fail. It's been free and stable since day one, focusing purely on what actually helps students.
features: Trackr: Real-time attendance and marks tracking with historical trends
Schedule: Daily schedule and semester calendar with room info
UnitWise: 180+ subjects with notes, PPTs, PYQs, and YouTube playlists
CalcGPA: Grade prediction and CGPA impact estimation
MealMap: Daily mess menus for all university hostels
Finder: Faculty search by name or ID with staff room details
Join Community: Resource sharing and WhatsApp-integrated hub for 2500+ students
howItWorks: Students sign in with their university credentials. Studique fetches and caches their academic data - attendance, marks, timetable - and presents it in a clean dashboard. A background sync keeps data fresh, while the caching layer ensures the app stays fast even when university servers are slow or down.
useCases: Checking daily attendance before class cutoff deadlines
Finding PPTs and PYQs for exams via UnitWise
Checking hostel mess menus via MealMap
Predicting SGPA/CGPA impact with CalcGPA

title: Interact
desc: A product for people joining hackathons without a team, focused on teammate discovery and smoother early collaboration.
mobileDesc: A product that helps hackathon participants find teammates and collaborate faster.
overview: Interact is an iOS app designed to solve the teammate discovery problem at hackathons. Instead of scrambling on Discord or WhatsApp the night before, participants can find complementary teammates through skill-based matching and in-app coordination.
problem: Talented people at hackathons often can't find the right teammates. Team formation happens through random Discord messages or knowing someone - not through actual skill matching. This leads to poorly balanced teams and wasted potential.
solution: A swipe-style teammate discovery app scoped to specific hackathon events. Profiles highlight skills and project history, and built-in chat enables early collaboration before the event even starts.
features: Skill-based teammate matching with swipe-style discovery
Real-time in-app messaging for team coordination
Event-scoped rooms so conversations stay relevant
Profile builder with project history and skill tags
Push notification system for match alerts
howItWorks: Users create a profile with their skills and project experience. When a hackathon event is active, they browse other participants through a card-based interface, filtering by complementary skills. Mutual interest creates a match and opens a direct chat for team coordination.
useCases: Finding a backend developer when you only have frontend skills
Forming balanced teams before a hackathon starts
Connecting with participants from different colleges at inter-university events
Building a network of hackathon collaborators over time

title: GetItDone
desc: A freelance marketplace connecting clients and freelancers with a secure escrow system, project tracking, and dispute resolution.
mobileDesc: A freelance marketplace with secure escrow payments and project tracking.
overview: GetItDone is a freelance marketplace built to address trust gaps in peer-to-peer service transactions. It uses a milestone-based escrow system where funds are held until deliverables are verified, giving both clients and freelancers confidence in every project.
problem: Existing freelance platforms take massive cuts, favor established sellers, and offer limited protection for new freelancers and clients. Trust is the biggest barrier - clients fear non-delivery, freelancers fear non-payment.
solution: A milestone-based escrow payment system where funds are held securely until each deliverable is verified. Built-in dispute resolution with evidence uploads provides a fair arbitration process when things go wrong.
features: Milestone-based escrow payment system
Real-time project tracking with progress dashboards
Built-in dispute resolution with evidence uploads
Freelancer verification and portfolio system
Smart matching algorithm based on skills and ratings
howItWorks: Clients post projects with milestones and budgets. Freelancers browse and apply based on their skills. Once matched, funds are locked in escrow per milestone. Freelancers deliver, clients verify, and funds release automatically. Disputes trigger an evidence-based arbitration workflow.
useCases: Hiring a developer for a specific feature with milestone-based payment
Getting design work done with built-in revision tracking
Resolving payment disputes through evidence-based arbitration
Building a verified freelancer profile for future opportunities

title: herSpace
desc: A private offline-first cycle tracking app built to keep personal data on-device with a calm and simple experience.
mobileDesc: A private offline-first cycle tracker built around simplicity and on-device privacy.
overview: herSpace is a fully offline-first cycle tracking app for iOS. It was designed with a single principle: your most personal health data should never leave your device. No accounts, no cloud sync, no analytics - just a calm, minimal interface that respects privacy by default.
problem: Most cycle tracking apps send data to servers, share with third parties, or require accounts. After major privacy concerns around health data, users lost trust in cloud-based trackers. There was no simple, private-by-design alternative.
solution: A fully offline iOS app with zero network requests. Cycle predictions run entirely on-device using lightweight statistical algorithms, and all data stays in the user's local Core Data store protected by biometric lock.
features: Fully offline - zero network requests, no accounts needed
Cycle predictions using on-device statistical algorithms
Symptom and mood logging with customizable categories
HealthKit integration for holistic health tracking
Passcode and biometric lock for app access
howItWorks: Users log their cycle data locally. The app analyzes historical patterns using a lightweight on-device algorithm to predict future cycles with increasing accuracy. All data is stored in Core Data and protected by biometric authentication. Nothing ever leaves the device.
useCases: Tracking cycles without sharing data with any server
Getting accurate predictions that improve over time
Logging symptoms and moods alongside cycle data
Syncing health metrics with Apple Health locally

title: SRMConnect
desc: A platform for managing college communities, members, and events in one place instead of using scattered tools and workflows.
mobileDesc: A platform to manage college communities, members, and events from one place.
overview: SRMConnect is a unified platform for managing college clubs and communities. It replaces the patchwork of WhatsApp groups, Google Sheets, and email chains with a single dashboard for event creation, member management, and community communication.
problem: Running college clubs involves coordinating events, managing members, and communicating updates across scattered tools - WhatsApp, Sheets, email, Instagram. Nothing is centralized, nothing is searchable, and handoffs between leadership generations lose institutional knowledge.
solution: A purpose-built platform giving club leaders a unified dashboard for everything - from event creation and RSVP tracking to member roles and engagement analytics. Real-time announcements replace scattered group messages.
features: Community dashboards with member role management
Event creation with RSVP tracking and attendance
Real-time announcements via Socket.io
Analytics dashboard for engagement metrics
Exportable reports for club administrative needs
howItWorks: Club admins create a community space, invite members, and assign roles. Events are created with details and RSVP links. Members receive real-time announcements through Socket.io. An analytics dashboard tracks engagement, attendance trends, and member activity over time.
useCases: Managing a 200+ member technical club with sub-teams
Tracking event attendance and generating reports for college administration
Sending real-time announcements without relying on WhatsApp
Preserving institutional knowledge during leadership transitions

title: Brand Visuals
desc: Visual work for products and student communities focused on consistency, clarity, and stronger communication.
mobileDesc: Visual design work focused on clarity, consistency, and stronger communication.
overview: Brand Visuals is a collection of design work spanning product branding, social media assets, event graphics, and visual systems for student communities. Each project focused on building visual consistency - creating design languages that communities could maintain long after the initial work was done.
problem: Student communities produce inconsistent, ad-hoc visuals because there are no established brand systems. Every new poster or social media post is designed from scratch, leading to fragmented identity and wasted effort.
solution: Creating complete brand identity systems with reusable templates, clear guidelines, and component libraries in Figma - empowering non-designers to maintain visual consistency independently.
features: Complete brand identity systems with guidelines
Social media templates for consistent posting
Event promotional graphics and banner systems
Icon sets and illustration libraries
Motion graphics for digital announcements
howItWorks: Each project starts with understanding the community's identity and communication needs. I design a core visual system - colors, typography, spacing, logo usage - then build it into a Figma template library. Community members use these templates for day-to-day content creation without needing design skills.
useCases: Creating consistent social media posts for a college tech club
Designing event posters that match a community's brand identity
Building a reusable template system for non-designers
Producing motion graphics for Instagram stories and reels
